Cable Cat

A playful cable management solution | 2025

About

Cable Cat is a playful and functional solution for managing cables and cords. Combining whimsical design with practical utility, this project transforms the mundane task of cable organization into something delightful.

Design Concept

The design takes inspiration from the playful nature of cats and their tendency to interact with cables. Rather than hiding cables away, Cable Cat embraces them as part of the design, creating an interactive and charming desktop accessory.

Features

Cable Cat provides a fun way to organize and route cables while adding personality to your workspace. The design allows for easy cable insertion and removal while keeping everything tidy and accessible.

Materials & Construction

Built with attention to both form and function, Cable Cat combines durable materials with thoughtful design details that make cable management both effective and enjoyable.
